confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of July pricing in Alicante, a high-season Costa Blanca resort city; no live listings were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which varies by beach proximity and booking lead time. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are based on direct knowledge of tourist-area pricing. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that attribute the value to the RBA page; the RBA page itself was not opened directly. A third-party figure of 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 was seen but not used because it is not an official RBA source. Verify the FX value on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on coastal Spanish tourist cities with similar July demand, such as Valencia, Málaga and the Costa Blanca resort towns, adjusted for Alicante's somewhat lower prices than Barcelona or Madrid.
